meta.title: Yey — Three Stereo Pianos and BBC Discover

intent.one_thing: Expand only the piano into a complementary stereo trio, keeping every original chord and song position.

reference_pair.borrow: Exact 72-bar progression, slash basses, harmonic rhythm, silence and open B/D# ending.

reference_pair.track: Yey v002 piano and BBC arrangement
reference_pair.borrow: Connected upper contour, all six BBC performances, and space for cello/woodwind phrases.

intent.listener_situation: Stereo listening with a stable center and interlocking acoustic piano gestures at the sides.

material.motif: Two bars: a held center chord/top voice, a mid-register broken-chord rise and return on the left, answered by a high descending two/three-note phrase on the right.

spectrum_budget.resolution: Keep single piano bass in center and use v002 octave lift from bar 9.
Reduce left to two restrained notes per bar under theme; one line, no chord stack.
Center holds anchors while left attacks between center gestures; side touch is subordinate.
Right leaves every wind-containing bar silent.

subtraction_events.what: Lengthen and reduce both side figures
Remove right on cello entry and thin left
Reduce all piano gestures, soften progressively

arrangement_hook.what: Left broken-chord gesture answered by high right piano over a stable center chord.

push_pull.note: Workspace strict onset policy; touch/gate/CC provide phrase variation.

fill_policy.rationale: One extra soft left chord tone at selected seams, no new chord.

mix_intent.mood: A broad piano trio in one coherent acoustic space, with the original intimate orchestra behind it.

width_map.lead: Subdued around cello and wind rests
width_map.final: Recap then sparse sides in final four bars
